raw_segments.text: They went past the bleak pulpit of St. Mark's, under the railway bridge, past the Queen's
Hordings, Eugene Stratton, Mrs. Banman Palmer.
Could I go to see Lee tonight, I wonder?
I said I are the Lily of Killarney, Elster Grimes Opera Company.
Wet bright bills for next week.
Martin Cunningham could work a pass for the Giety.
Have to stand a drink or two, as broad as its long.
